---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity Residual Diagnostics and Robust Inference (dHCP)"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Residual diagnostics and robust inference for all reported models in the neonatal cohort (dHCP; Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 3): group comparison (CP \~ group + age at scan + sex) and GLMs in preterm-born neonates (degree of prematurity, SES, cognition at 18 months). Diagnostics per model: residual skewness and kurtosis, Shapiro-Wilk, Breusch-Pagan, Cook's distance; Q-Q and scale-location plots for the group comparison. All tests are repeated with HC3 standard errors and Freedman-Lane permutation tests (5,000 permutations), with FDR correction within the same families as in the main analyses.

- Input: `data/dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv`
- Outputs (`outputs/tables`):
  - `Revision_FDR_families_dHCP_<date>.csv`: tests per FDR family (results/fdr_families_dHCP.csv)
  - `Revision_diagnostics_CP_dHCP_<date>.csv`: distribution of CP per ROI (results/diagnostics_CP_distribution_dHCP.csv)
  - `Revision_residdiag_groupcomp_dHCP_<date>.csv`, `Revision_residdiag_GLMs_dHCP_<date>.csv`: residual diagnostics (results/diagnostics_residuals_groupcomp_dHCP.csv, diagnostics_residuals_GLMs_dHCP.csv)
  - `Revision_robustness_dHCP_<date>.csv`: parametric, HC3 and permutation P-values (results/robustness_HC3_permutation_dHCP.csv)
- Figures (`outputs/figures`): Q-Q and scale-location plots, `Revision313_dHCP_*.png`; `Revision313_FigSX_QQ_sigROIs_AB.png` (Supplementary Figure S8; combines the dHCP and BLS Q-Q plots, run `Revision_3_1_3_robustness_BLS.qmd` first)

## Specific setup

```{r}
options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))

# covariates in every model
covars    <- c("scan_age", "sex")
covar_rhs <- paste(covars, collapse = " + ")

# degree of prematurity
prematurity_vars <- c("birth_age", "birth_weight")

# SES
ses_var <- "ses_score"

# cognition at 18 months
cog_var <- "bsid_cog_composite"

# descriptive threshold for "near zero" CP (fewer than 1 in 1000 seeded streamlines reaching the target) for table
NEAR_ZERO <- 0.001

# number of permutations
NPERM <- 5000
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat_dHCP <- read_delim(
  here("data", "dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv"),
  delim = ",",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = "."),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject_ID = col_character(),
    Session_ID = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

dat_dHCP <- dat_dHCP |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      group == "term" ~ "FT",
      group == "pre"  ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
    
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

### Make data subsets

```{r}
cp_vars_dHCP <- grep("^l_|^r_", names(dat_dHCP), value = TRUE)

num_vars <- c(cp_vars_dHCP, "scan_age", prematurity_vars, ses_var, cog_var)

dat_dHCP <- dat_dHCP |>
  mutate(across(all_of(num_vars), as.numeric))

dat_dHCP_PT <- dat_dHCP |> dplyr::filter(group == "PT")
```

### Checks

```{r}
stopifnot(length(cp_vars_dHCP) == 22)
stopifnot(all(cp_vars_dHCP %in% names(roi_labels)))
stopifnot(all(sig_roi_codes_dHCP %in% cp_vars_dHCP))

stopifnot(all(num_vars %in% names(dat_dHCP)))
stopifnot(all(sapply(dat_dHCP[num_vars], is.numeric)))
```

## Overview of reported models

```{r}
models_dHCP <- bind_rows(
  # Group comparison: CP ~ group + age + sex (full cohort)
  tibble(
    analysis = "GC group comparison",
    family   = "GC: group",
    dv       = cp_vars_dHCP,
    rhs      = paste("group +", covar_rhs),
    data     = "dat_dHCP",
    term     = "groupPT",
    roi      = cp_vars_dHCP
  ),
  # Analysis 1: CP ~ prematurity variable + age + sex (PT only)
  crossing(dv = cp_vars_dHCP, term = prematurity_vars) |>
    mutate(
      analysis = "A1 prematurity",
      family   = paste("A1:", term),
      rhs      = paste(term, "+", covar_rhs),
      data     = "dat_dHCP_PT",
      roi      = dv
    ),
  # Analysis 2: CP ~ SES + age + sex (PT only)
  tibble(
    analysis = "A2 SES",
    family   = paste("A2:", ses_var),
    dv       = cp_vars_dHCP,
    rhs      = paste(ses_var, "+", covar_rhs),
    data     = "dat_dHCP_PT",
    term     = ses_var,
    roi      = cp_vars_dHCP
  ),
  # Analysis 3: Bayley-III cognition ~ CP + age + sex (PT only)
  tibble(
    analysis = "A3 cognition 18mo",
    family   = paste("A3:", cog_var),
    dv       = cog_var,
    rhs      = paste(cp_vars_dHCP, "+", covar_rhs),
    data     = "dat_dHCP_PT",
    term     = cp_vars_dHCP,
    roi      = cp_vars_dHCP
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    ROI   = dplyr::recode(roi, !!!roi_labels),
    model = paste(dv, "~", rhs)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(analysis, family, ROI, roi, dv, rhs, data, term, model)

# FDR families: number of tests per family
fdr_families_dHCP <- models_dHCP |> count(analysis, family, name = "n_tests")

readr::write_csv2(fdr_families_dHCP,
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_FDR_families_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

# 2 Diagnostics

## Helper functions

### Skewness/Kurtosis

```{r}
skew    <- function(x) e1071::skewness(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2)
ex_kurt <- function(x) e1071::kurtosis(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2)
```

### Residual diagnostics

```{r}
resid_diag <- function(fml, data) {
  d <- model.frame(fml, data = data, na.action = na.omit)
  
  fit    <- lm(fml, data = d)
  r      <- residuals(fit)
  cooksd <- cooks.distance(fit)
  sw     <- stats::shapiro.test(r)
  
  tibble(
    n             = nobs(fit),
    df_resid      = df.residual(fit),
    skew_resid    = skew(r),
    kurt_resid    = ex_kurt(r),
    shapiro_W     = unname(sw$statistic),
    shapiro_p     = sw$p.value,
    bp_p          = lmtest::bptest(fit)$p.value,
    max_cooksd    = max(cooksd),
    n_cooksd_high = sum(cooksd > 4 / nobs(fit))
  )
}
```

## 2.1 Distribution of raw CP per ROI

```{r}
cp_dist_dHCP <- map_dfr(cp_vars_dHCP, function(v) {
  x <- dat_dHCP[[v]]
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  tibble(
    dv            = v,
    ROI           = dplyr::recode(v, !!!roi_labels),
    n             = length(x),
    mean          = mean(x),
    sd            = sd(x),
    min           = min(x),
    max           = max(x),
    n_zero        = sum(x == 0),
    pct_zero      = 100 * mean(x == 0),
    pct_near_zero = 100 * mean(x < NEAR_ZERO),
    skew          = skew(x),
    kurtosis      = ex_kurt(x),
    floor_in_sd   = mean(x) / sd(x)
  )
}) |> arrange(floor_in_sd)

readr::write_csv2(cp_dist_dHCP,
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_diagnostics_CP_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

## 2.2 Residual diagnostics on all reported models

```{r}
models_unique_dHCP <- models_dHCP |> distinct(analysis, ROI, dv, rhs, data, model)

diag_dHCP <- pmap_dfr(models_unique_dHCP, function(analysis, ROI, dv, rhs, data, model) {
  out <- resid_diag(as.formula(model), get(data))
  mutate(out, analysis = analysis, ROI = ROI, model = model, .before = 1)
}) |>
  mutate(
    flag = case_when(
      abs(skew_resid) > 1 | bp_p < 0.05 ~ "assumptions questionable",
      abs(skew_resid) > 0.5             ~ "mild departure",
      TRUE                              ~ "ok"
    )
  )

diag_group_dHCP <- diag_dHCP |>
  dplyr::filter(analysis == "GC group comparison") |>
  arrange(desc(abs(skew_resid)))

readr::write_csv2(diag_group_dHCP,
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_residdiag_groupcomp_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
readr::write_csv2(dplyr::filter(diag_dHCP, analysis != "GC group comparison"),
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_residdiag_GLMs_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

## 2.3 Figures

```{r}
diag_panel_png <- function(dvs, which_plot, file, data, rhs,
                           labels = roi_labels, ncol = 5, cex_main = 0.9) {
  nr <- ceiling(length(dvs) / ncol)
  png(file, width = 300 * ncol, height = 280 * nr, res = 110)
  op <- par(mfrow = c(nr, ncol), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  for (dv in dvs) {
    fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", rhs))
    d   <- model.frame(fml, data = data, na.action = na.omit)
    fit <- lm(fml, data = d)
    plot(fit, which = which_plot,
         main = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!labels),
         sub.caption = "", caption = "", cex.main = cex_main)
  }
  par(op)
  dev.off()
  message("Saved: ", file)
}

rhs_group <- paste("group +", covar_rhs)

# --- All 22 ROIs ---
diag_panel_png(cp_vars_dHCP, which_plot = 2,
               file = file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_dHCP_QQ_all22.png"),
               data = dat_dHCP, rhs = rhs_group)

diag_panel_png(cp_vars_dHCP, which_plot = 3,
               file = file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_dHCP_scaleloc_all22.png"),
               data = dat_dHCP, rhs = rhs_group)

# --- FDR-significant ROIs only ---
diag_panel_png(sig_roi_codes_dHCP, which_plot = 2,
               file = file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_dHCP_QQ_sigROIs.png"),
               data = dat_dHCP, rhs = rhs_group)

diag_panel_png(sig_roi_codes_dHCP, which_plot = 3,
               file = file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_dHCP_scaleloc_sigROIs.png"),
               data = dat_dHCP, rhs = rhs_group)
```

### Multi-panel dHCP & BLS figure for supplement

```{r}
a <- image_read(file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_dHCP_QQ_sigROIs.png"))
b <- image_read(file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_BLS_QQ_sigROIs.png"))

w <- max(image_info(a)$width, image_info(b)$width)
add_label <- function(img, lab) {
  h   <- image_info(img)$height
  img <- image_extent(img, paste0(w, "x", h), gravity = "west", color = "white")
  img <- image_extent(img, paste0(w, "x", h + 70), gravity = "south", color = "white")
  image_annotate(img, lab, gravity = "northwest", location = "+15+10", size = 50, weight = 700)
}

fig <- image_append(c(add_label(a, "A"), add_label(b, "B")), stack = TRUE)
image_write(fig, file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_FigSX_QQ_sigROIs_AB.png"), format = "png")
```

# 3 Robust/permutation-based inference

## Helper function

```{r}
robust_p <- function(fml, data, terms, nperm = NPERM) {
  d   <- model.frame(fml, data = data, na.action = na.omit)
  fit <- lm(fml, data = d)
  cf  <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  
  missing_terms <- setdiff(terms, rownames(cf))
  if (length(missing_terms)) {
    stop("Term(s) ", paste(missing_terms, collapse = ", "),
         " not found in model: ", paste(deparse(fml), collapse = ""))
  }
  
  # HC3 robust standard errors
  hc3 <- lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3"))
  
  # Freedman-Lane permutation
  perm     <- permuco::lmperm(fml, data = d, np = nperm, method = "freedman_lane")
  perm_tab <- as.data.frame(perm$table)
  if (!"resampled Pr(>|t|)" %in% names(perm_tab)) {
    stop("Column 'resampled Pr(>|t|)' not found in lmperm() output")
  }
  if (!all(terms %in% rownames(perm_tab))) {
    stop("Term name(s) differ between lm() and lmperm() output")
  }
  
  tibble(
    term      = terms,
    n         = nobs(fit),
    df_resid  = df.residual(fit),
    estimate  = cf[terms, "Estimate"],
    std_error = cf[terms, "Std. Error"],
    t_value   = cf[terms, "t value"],
    p_param   = cf[terms, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    p_hc3     = hc3[terms, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    p_perm    = perm_tab[terms, "resampled Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}
```

## Run all tests

```{r}
set.seed(42)

model_keys <- models_dHCP |> dplyr::distinct(model, data)

rob_dHCP <- purrr::map2_dfr(model_keys$model, model_keys$data, function(m, dat_name) {
  rows <- models_dHCP |>
    dplyr::filter(model == m, data == dat_name) |>
    dplyr::select(analysis, family, ROI, dv, term)
  out <- robust_p(as.formula(m), get(dat_name), rows$term)
  dplyr::left_join(rows, out, by = "term")
})

stopifnot(nrow(rob_dHCP) == nrow(models_dHCP))

rob_dHCP <- rob_dHCP |>
  group_by(family) |>
  mutate(
    p_param_fdr = p.adjust(p_param, "fdr"),
    p_hc3_fdr   = p.adjust(p_hc3,   "fdr"),
    p_perm_fdr  = p.adjust(p_perm,  "fdr")
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    sig_param = p_param_fdr < 0.05,
    sig_hc3   = p_hc3_fdr   < 0.05,
    sig_perm  = p_perm_fdr  < 0.05,
    agree     = (sig_param == sig_hc3) & (sig_param == sig_perm)
  )
```

## Save results

```{r}
readr::write_csv2(rob_dHCP,
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_robustness_dHCP_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```
